newsitem.title: USA: Saratoga Brands to acquire Global Auto.
newsitem.headline: Saratoga Brands to acquire Global Auto.

text.p: Saratoga Brands Inc says it has reached an agreement subject to certain conditions to acquire Global Auto Group Inc.
Saratoga Brands will pay $9.8 million in Saratoga's common stock with the potential for additional consideration pursuant to the earn-out provisions.
The acquisition is expected to be completed within 30 days.
Global Auto Group is in the retail auto business.
Saratoga Brands, through its subsidiaries, provides catering services to convenience stores and imports specialty foods.
